using LinearAlgebra

function vander(x, k=nothing)
    if isnothing(k)
        k = length(x)
    end
    m = length(x)
    V = ones(m, k)
    for j in 2:k
        V[:, j] = V[:, j-1] .* x
    end
    V
end

function gram_schmidt_classical(A)
    m, n = size(A)
    Q = zeros(m, n)
    R = zeros(n, n)
    for j in 1:n
        v = A[:,j]
        R[1:j-1,j] = Q[:,1:j-1]' * v
        v -= Q[:,1:j-1] * R[1:j-1,j]
        R[j,j] = norm(v)
        Q[:,j] = v / R[j,j]
    end
    Q, R
end

function qr_householder(A)
    m, n = size(A)
    R = copy(A)
    V = [] # list of reflectors
    for j in 1:n
        v = copy(R[j:end, j])
        v[1] += sign(v[1]) * norm(v) # <---
        v = normalize(v)
        R[j:end,j:end] -= 2 * v * v' * R[j:end,j:end]
        push!(V, v)
    end
    V, R
end

function qr_chol(A)
    R = cholesky(A' * A).U
    Q = A / R
    Q, R
end

function qr_chol2(A)
    Q, R = qr_chol(A)
    Q, R1 = qr_chol(Q)
    Q, R1 * R
end
